hebrew:
חַדֵּשׁ שְׂשׂונִי אֵל נָא

וְהָבִיא אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא:

אַמֵּץ וְחַזֵּק רִפְיון יָדִי,

בָּרֵךְ מְלַאכְתִּי וְכָל מַעֲבָדִי,

גּואֲלִי זְכור עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי,

דְּבָרְךָ הַטּוב הָקֵם לְעודְדִי.

הָרֵץ וּשְׁלַח וְשַׂמַּח לְבָבִי,

אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא, אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא:

וָעֵד וְהָכֵן דֵּי סִפּוּקִי,

זַמֵּן מְזונִי לֶחֶם חֻקִּי,

חֵלֶב וְכָל טוּב חִישׁ לְהָנִיקִי,

טוּבְךָ תְּשַׂבַּע עולְלִי וְיונְקִי,

יָבא מְשִׁיחִי לְעִיר מושָׁבִי,

אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא, אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא:

כּונֵן לְעַם זוּ צוּרִי צוּר לַחֲבושׁ,

לֶחֶם לֶאֱכול וּבֶגֶד לִלְבּושׁ,

מְקַנְאִי יֶחֱזֶה יִרְאֶה וְיֵבושׁ,

נְוֵה הַר צִיּון בְּקָרוב תִּכְבּושׁ,

שְׂשׂונִי יִגְדַּל בִּרְאות סְבִיבִי,

אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא, אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא:

עַמּון וּמואָב אותָם תְּכַלֶּה,

פְּדוּתְךָ לְעַמְּךָ בְּקָרוב תְּגַלֶּה,

צִיּון תְּמַלֵּא מֵעַם אֵלֶּה,

קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב אָז נַעֲלֶה,

שַׁכֵּן תְּשַׁכֵּן בְּתוךְ עמי,

אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא, אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ הַנָּבִיא:
translation:
Renew my youthful joy, O G-d, I plead, and bring the prophet Eliyahu.

Firm and strengthen my weakened hand,

Bless my labour and all my works.

My Redeemer, remember my affliction and my sorrow.

Establish Your beneficial word to encourage me.

Hasten and send, gladden my heart,

The prophet Eliyahu, the prophet Eliyahu.

Gather and prepare enough for my needs,

Prepare my food and allotted bread,

Fatness and all goodness hurry to nurture me.

With Your goodness, satiate my infant and my suckling,

May my Messiah come to the city of my dwelling,

The prophet Eliyahu, the prophet Eliyahu.

Prepare for this nation, my Rock, O Rock, to heal the wound;

Bread to eat and clothes to don,

May those who envy me look, see and be shamed.

The palace of Mount Sion may You soon conquer;

My joy will grow when I see around me,

the prophet Eliyahu, the prophet Eliyahu.

Ammon and Moab may You destroy,

Your redemption for Your people may You soon reveal.

May You populate Sion with this people,

to the Great King's city we will then ascend.

Cause to be present among the beloved people,

the prophet Eliyahu, the prophet Eliyahu.
information:
This pizmon, of unknown authorship, first appears in Mahzor Vitry at the turn of the 13th century. The name of the composer has been variously deciphered from the acrostic of either the first stich, חשאן, Hassan, or of the second stich, אורי, Uri, or from the last letters of the first four words, שילא, Shila.

It is a plea for redemption and prosperity on the personal level, and for the ultimate conquest of Israel's enemies. All these hopes are attached to the coming of Eliyahu, the herald of the Messiah.

recordings.description: Sung by Sara Aliza Godinger (nee Frankel)
